Worker retained-heap ceiling256MiB and renderer peak working-set ceiling1GiB are pre-formal engineering bounds, roughly1.7x current raw high-water values, not retrospective user SLA or OS limits. Main post-GC30MiB bound means all measured document tabs closed and no source intentionally retained by the observer; active document heap and source buffers are recorded separately. UI long tasks are measured from original parse post through first real window paint, with full-source hashing/serialization outside the measured interval.

Raw Node parent tick gaps are not browser long tasks. Natural App/I samples exclude explicit transport delay, invalid-window and startup-throw faults. Formal cancellation requires actual native target destruction, not only terminate() returning.
budget.changePolicy: Frozen before formal performance acceptance. Keep failures and raw measures; never relax this budget, replace inputs, change memory scope or count partial/mocked rendering as full success to obtain a pass.
